mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(metric_time, #{datePattern}) AS timeLabel, AVG(metric_value) AS avgValue, MAX(metric_value) AS `maxValue`, MIN(metric_value) AS `minValue` FROM t_metric_data WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND type_code = #{typeCode} AND metric_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY timeLabel ORDER BY timeLabel
